name: mcp-keeper
stderr:
Usage: mcp-keeper [options] [command]

Security, token-cost and quality checks for MCP servers and client configs.

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  scan [options] [command...]  Connect to an MCP server and check what it
                               exposes to the model.
  config [options] [files...]  Audit MCP client config files (Claude, Cursor,
                               VS Code, Windsurf, …) for plaintext secrets,
                               unpinned packages and risky settings.
  rules                        List all checks.
  help [command]               display help for command
